candidates.description: This vector represents multilingual characters, sub-word tokens, and terms related to abstract concepts or translation artifacts across various languages.
This feature vector represents linguistic tokens, particularly Hindi script characters and words, associated with various parts of speech and punctuation.
This vector activates on common Devanagari root syllables and prefixes shared across various Sanskrit and Hindi words.
This vector represents the Devanagari character 'भ' (bha) and its common combinations with vowels and consonants.
This feature vector represents common prefixes and foundational character roots in the Hindi Devanagari script.

This feature vector activates on a heterogeneous mix of Hindi-script subwords and isolated English tokens, suggesting it functions as a general-purpose tokenization artifact or noise filter in the model's embedding space.
This vector represents the letter 'प' (pa) and its various conjunct forms in the Devanagari script.
These tokens represent Devanagari vowel sign and dependent vowel modifiers attached to commas.
This vector represents common Marathi suffixes and rhyming sub-word lexical components.
This vector represents common Hindi vowel signs, character fragments, and short grammatical suffixes.
